status: Exploratory follow-up after original 2025-2026 results were known
opening_definition: Batter or non-striker on the first recorded event of an ordinary innings; score only their eligible deliveries in that innings
primary_split: Original shared calendar midpoint by season, with whole dates kept together
multiplier_selection: Minimum 2024 all-late-opening delivery-weighted log loss, tie favouring multiplier closest to 1
claim_limit: Conditional predictive comparison; neither a fresh confirmatory test nor proof of player ability change
